Alvin plans to pull the curtain back on his boss, but has to watch his toes going against Victoria.

programme.title: Till Lies Do Us Part
programme.desc: Amina and Alex announce their engagement to their family and friends after only dating for six months, and are having a destination wedding at that. As the romantic and loving getaway goes along, betrayals and hidden truths come to the surface causing chaos and drama.

programme.title: The Loyalty Test
programme.desc: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star that has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, successfully turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

programme.title: Brick Nash
programme.desc: Brick Nash returns home after several years following his father’s mysterious death, hoping to solve the mystery of his death. What begins as a search for answers quickly pulls him into a dangerous world of hidden money, violent criminals, and powerful people with secrets they’ll do anything to protect.

programme.title: Hated By Many Loved By None
programme.desc: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, Tomeka and Honey, by her side, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life. But as money, power, and new connections take over, loyalty quickly turns into betrayal.

programme.title: Stalked
programme.desc: Malachi, a talented but struggling artist and Kiana, an aspiring model leaves Philadelphia for Atlanta seeing better opportunities, and together the two’s careers begin to take off. But when Malachi meets Shante, her seductive charm and beauty pull him in, and her obsession threatens to destroy everything he and Kiana have built together.

programme.title: Kiss Me Once
programme.desc: Gabrielle, a delusional romantic, fixates on anyone who shows her the slightest interest. Her obsession turns dangerous when her feelings aren't reciprocated.

programme.title: The Miracle of Tonya Pinkins
programme.desc: A musical biographical documentary about the life, times and career of Tony Award winner and Broadway performing star Tonya Pinkins (Jelly’s Last Jam, Play On, Caroline or Change) the movie chronicles her beginning as a professional child actress in Chicago to an award winning Broadway star, along with the stories and songs that made her one of America’s top performing artists.

programme.title: Hoodie Girls Gang
programme.desc: Kayla's boyfriend Jamal is jailed and needs $10,000 bail. Desperate, Kayla and her friends plan an armed robbery. However, the heist goes wrong, and the police are on their trail. To make matters worse, Jamal's boss, Sean, demands payment for the drugs Jamal was transporting. Kayla must now free Jamal and escape town before both the police and Sean catch up to her.

programme.title: Single Black Female
programme.desc: Rose is a young college freshman who meets her roommate Max for the first time. The two develop an intense bond, and Max is willing to prove her loyalty to Rose, even if it means someone will have to die if they get in the way.

programme.title: The Special Affect
programme.desc: Expecting mother & artist, Destiny, spirals after a tragic loss. Her loving husband helps her cope, but a bad trip and missed meds spark disturbing memories. With the help of her best friend, Destiny uncovers a horrifying truth about her past.

programme.title: Deeper
programme.desc: The story of Chasity, King, and Gotti is a tale of love, betrayal, and power. Gotti returns with a vengeance, seeking to reclaim his Dallas Kingpin status and Chasity's love. Despite their challenges, Chasity and King remain determined. As they plan their future, Gotti's secrets and power grab threaten their love. Will they triumph over his schemes or will he steal her heart? Follow their journey in the dangerous world of the hustle.

programme.title: Curse of a Father
programme.desc: A father’s horrible mistake causes a lifetime of pain for his children. His son tries his best to live a normal life, but his childhood trauma follows him into his marriage. He must face his trauma head on to break this generational curse.

programme.title: The Hit List
programme.desc: Marcus is a ladies’ man until he meets Nia, the woman of his dreams. However, Nia’s brother has a psychic ability that threatens to expose Marcus as the player he is, leading him to extreme measures with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Vices
programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. When a storm isolates her in her remote cabin, she’s hunted by two forces: the seductive pull of her past addiction, and a cunning serial killer. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

programme.title: And They Named Her Love
programme.desc: Love, a hopeless romantic painter, sets out on a cross country journey to find herself in the competitive world of artistry. When a near death experience brings Atlanta based songstress Nasada into her life, she goes on a journey to find out that love and business do not always mix.

programme.title: The Sermon
programme.desc: When a charismatic pastor’s sermons begin to influence a group of men searching for purpose, their actions evolve into a series of calculated crimes carried out in the name of righteousness.

programme.title: Camera Girl
programme.desc: After witnessing Atlanta’s underground rap scene firsthand, a quiet but driven young woman buys her first camera and sets out to become a music videographer. But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programme.title: Why Not You
programme.desc: Young executive Quincy Jackson finds himself at odds with his current girlfriend, when he discovers his coworker Joi is in a similar situation of her own. As they bond over their relationship troubles, their fates become intertwined.

programme.title: His Target
programme.desc: Keya meets Justin, an aspiring entrepreneur and thought she found the man of her dreams, but he saw her as an opportunity to make his ventures soar. The closer she gets to him, the more she falls in love, but his grip grows tighter and deadlier. A toxic relationship, soon grows into a power struggle with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Ryan's Daughter
programme.desc: An Irish lass is branded a traitor when she falls for a British soldier.

programme.title: The Wonderful World of the Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: Fanciful biography of the German fairy-tale collectors.

programme.title: Ivanhoe
programme.desc: Ivanhoe risks everything for his king and for Rebecca, the woman he loves.

programme.title: Out West With the Hardys
programme.desc: A judge takes his family out West to help a friend negotiate water rights.

programme.title: Ben-Hur
programme.desc: A rebellious Israelite prince crosses paths with Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Without Love
programme.desc: Two single people try platonic marriage, and vow there will be no romance.

programme.title: Judge Hardy and Son
programme.desc: A small-town judge tries to save an elderly couple from eviction.

programme.title: Bullitt
programme.desc: Steve McQueen is an officer unraveling the mafia ties behind a shooting.

programme.title: What's Up, Doc?
programme.desc: A luggage mix-up causes chaos for a music researcher.

programme.title: Gun Crazy
programme.desc: Bart and Annie share a passion for guns and go on a murderous crime spree.

programme.title: No Time For Sergeants
programme.desc: A hillbilly draftee turns the Air Force upside down.

programme.title: Life Begins for Andy Hardy
programme.desc: A small-town boy tries life in the big city before going to college.

programme.title: The Big Store
programme.desc: A detective and his zany pals take over a failing department store.

programme.title: Dodge City
programme.desc: A soldier of fortune takes on the corrupt boss of a western town.

programme.title: Grand Hotel
programme.desc: Guests at a posh Berlin hotel struggle through scandal and heartache.

programme.title: McCabe and Mrs. Miller
programme.desc: A gambler and a prostitute go into business together in a mining town.

programme.title: Them!
programme.desc: Federal agents fight to destroy a colony of mutated giant ants.

programme.title: Cabaret
programme.desc: A singer and a club's MC try to bring happiness to the lives of Berliners.

programme.title: Seven Brides for Seven Brothers
programme.desc: Milly teaches the seven Pontipee brothers how to find wives.

programme.title: Dark Victory
programme.desc: A spoiled heiress discovers inner strength when she develops a brain tumor.

programme.title: The Candidate
programme.desc: An image maker grooms a political boss' son for a bid in the Senate race.

programme.title: Mutiny on the Bounty
programme.desc: A first mate leads his crew in mutiny against their sadistic captain.

programme.title: Forbidden Planet
programme.desc: A stranded human deciphers alien secrets but won't share his knowledge.

programme.title: Westbound
programme.desc: A Civil War veteran protects a gold shipment from a Confederate officer.

programme.title: Tension at Table Rock
programme.desc: When the owner of a stagecoach station is killed, a gunman takes his place.

programme.title: Sergeant York
programme.desc: Gary Cooper plays a pacifist who became a great World War I hero.

programme.title: Downstairs
programme.desc: An evil chauffeur seduces and blackmails his way through high society.

programme.title: Desperate Journey
programme.desc: American pilots stranded during World War II fight their way to freedom.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: Nobody believes a woman when she reports a murder in a neighbor's house.

programme.title: They Were Expendable
programme.desc: PT boat captains fight Japanese ships in the World War II Philippines.

programme.title: Cahill, United States Marshal
programme.desc: A big bank robbery takes Marshal Cahill on a dangerous chase.

programme.title: Dial M for Murder
programme.desc: A husband frames his wife for the murder of the man he'd hired to kill her.

programme.title: All This, and Heaven Too
programme.desc: A French nobleman falls in love with his children's governess.

programme.title: 36 Hours
programme.desc: Nazis attempt to convince a kidnapped American officer that WWII is over.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet Captain Kidd
programme.desc: Abbott and Costello are on an island with deadly pirates.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Concrete Against Bombs
programme.desc: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.

programme.title: Facing Nuclear Annihilation
programme.desc: The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.

programme.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War
programme.desc: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.

programme.title: Designed for Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler’s mastery of propaganda, and his instinctive skill for effective design, helps win huge popular support for the Nazi party, a vital step in its march towards total power.

programme.title: Hitler's Highways
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler promises to make Germany great again with his ambitious plans to create 22,000 kms of motorway and build one and half million “People’s Cars” every year.

programme.title: The Industry of War
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to rebuild Germany’s military strength after its humiliating defeat in the First World War by stealing raw materials from abroad.

programme.title: A Culture of Control
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to change the way German people think and feel by creating a new, Nazi form of art and culture. He takes control of all forms of media to spread Nazi propaganda.

programme.title: Himmler's Empire of Terror
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler’s bid for power depends on his most loyal and violent supporters, the SS. They use intimidation, detention, terror and even murder to defeat all the Nazis political enemies.

programme.title: Retreat from Reality
programme.desc: Hitler uses technology and terror to keep Germans fighting to the bitter end.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Rising Sun
programme.desc: After briefly setting the scene, Episode One delves into the early years of Emperor Hirohito’s reign.

programme.title: For the Sake of the Country
programme.desc: Episode Two explores the military’s tightening control over Japanese society, the disbanding of labour unions and influences upon education.

programme.title: The Sun that Shines
programme.desc: Japan seized more than 2,500,000 km² of land in Southeast Asia and almost the entire western half of the Pacific.

programme.title: An Extraordinary Measure
programme.desc: On the day that Nagasaki was bombed, the Trans Baikal and 2nd Far East Fronts of the Red Army invaded Manchuria, the 1st Far East Front moved from Vladivostok.

programme.title: Countdown to Surrender: The End
programme.desc: The final act of the Second World War is its most costly episode. More than one million German soldiers die in 1945 alone.

programme.desc: Tracing the origins and solving the mystery of a controversial all-aluminum bodied 512 BBI Boxer Ferrari.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes Turbo in the Twin Cities; Ferrari Drifter Federico Sceriffo finds a home in Atlanta.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray finds Buried Treasures in the form of two race cars that had been left almost completely untouched since the last time they were on a race track. One is found sitting in a barn with the other trapped in an old car hauler. Upon uncovering the cars, we find both have big stories to tell.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A journey to Indianapolis unveils the winning car of the 1955 Indy 500 sits on the roof of an auto mechanic shop. More than 50 years after it’s magic at the track, prominent Indy mechanic/owner Chris Paulsen begins to restore the car and Ray talks about the evolution of America’s illustrious Indy 500.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Smokey Yunick, the most innovative mechanic in NASCAR history, sold his famous truck that hauled equipment & cars across the country. Ray is on a mission to uncover this storied truck that helped launch the beginning of NASCAR’s cross-country popularity.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray travels to Long Island, New York with the hopes of learning more about America’s first major auto racing competition. The race, which began at the turn of the 20th century, helped develop the first major American racing stars and drove American manufacturing to competitive standard with the highly progressive Europeans.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Fred Dmuchowski is a New Jersey racing icon. He was a regular workingman who raced on weekends for fun and became a legend in his iconic 303 racer. Ray works to rebuild the 303 in homage to Fred who inspired him to pursue his career in motorsports.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Jaguar F-Type Project 7 crosses the Pond.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Mustang Mayhem at the big show.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Red carpet receptions for a Koenigsegg Regera.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Covert cars that slipped into the U.S.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: "Go Fast Girl" Katherne Legge's Model A Racer.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Mecum Auction's push for a $15,000,000 sale.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Doubling down for cars and coffee.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: British Invasion through the decades.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Due diligence on custom builds and their quirky builders.

programme.desc: Rickey, Bryan and Adam explore all the cars that should never have been built at Concourse d'lemons.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Willie B. and Kevin go under the hood of the new Mustang EcoBoost 4-cylinder to add some performance upgrades. Meanwhile, progress on an old pickup project continues with rust repair and new body panels.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: When a 1969 Camaro with bad body roll is delivered to the shop, Kevin and Willie tackle the suspension to help it perform better on the track.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie build a new bed for an ongoing 1973 truck project before solving some issues with the hub assembly on a hefty F-350.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Federated Auto Parts send Willie B. and Kevin a Jeep Wrangler to outfit with a new Dana 44 and a few other upgrades for a lucky winner.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage

programme.desc: What does it take to go from 2-wheel drive to 4-wheel drive? A new transfer case, front axle and transmission parts to name a few. Your not going to want miss this 4 wheel drive conversion today on Truck U.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Today on Truck U we’ll show you what it takes to pick out the right donor truck for your next project and give you an inside look at some of the problems areas inside the engine.

programme.desc: How do you get a truck to sell faster at a dealership? Bring it to Truck U and let them have their way with it. See if Matt and Bruno can flip this Ford on Truck U.

programme.desc: Matt and Bruno customize a truck for a local alligator hunter.

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: If you want to know what makes a low center of gravity so important on a Jeep, then you won’t want to miss this episode.

programme.title: Truck U

programme.desc: When Willie and Kevin find a 1953 M37 sitting in a friend’s garage next to a Cummins 4BT and all the parts needed for an engine swap, they volunteer to provide the labor.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys have a sweet 1970 Chevelle in the shop with a worn-out interior and a problematic cowl induction system seal. Plus, Kevin tackles the daunting task of rebuilding an infamous Rochester Quadrajet Carburetor.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Willie stumbles across a beautiful 1966 Impala, but its beauty is only skin-deep. Under the hood are rusty headers, a grimy engine block, and a host of other needed repairs. It’s up to Willie and Kevin to restore this classic to its former glory.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: When the guys get their hands on a clean 1986 square-body C-10, they give it a facelift…and a suspension drop. With its brand-new look and stance, Willie and Kevin can’t wait to reveal the truck to its owner.

programme.desc: Kevin and Willie have an Autobahn edition 2013 MK6 VW GTI in the shop for performance upgrades. With a new turbo kit, exhaust, and a few other improvements, the guys plan to boost this car’s status from “daily driver” to “head-turner.”

programme.desc: A friend of Kevin and Willie has not one, but two work trucks that need improvements for hauling heavy loads. Can the guys handle this double-order and finish both trucks in time for the owner to get them back on the job?

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati is in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations - Puerto Vallarta. She gets an insider's tour of the best street food from one of the town's most acclaimed chefs, Thierry Boulet.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits the birthplace of Mexico's most famous spirit, the town of Tequila. Back home Pati makes a brunch of corn tortilla egg nests with salsa verde con chile de árbol and traditional arroz rojo.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

programme.desc: In this episode we focus on the dynamics of the driving force of natural migrations. The seasonal movement of wild animals between pastures is a natural phenomenon, but not everywhere.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "The Human Touch"
programme.desc: The true meaning of conservation manifests when man and nature unite – separation is not an option. This episode focuses on the human involvement in what used to be a natural process.

programme.desc: In this episode we relocate two of the largest antelope species in Africa, the Kudu and the Waterbuck. Both these species require a helicopter and very competent ground crew.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Black Rhino"
programme.desc: Classified as critically endangered, these animals are known for their unpredictable and aggressive behaviour when approached or caught unaware. Join the capture team in an adventurous capture exercise at the Hluhluwe-Imfolozi Park.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Tiny Diving Antelope"
programme.desc: One of the smallest antelope species – the red duiker thrives in the sub-tropical bushveld of the Kwa-Zulu Natal province. This very sensitive animal will be captured in nets, gently removed, and sent on their way to a new home.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Gentle Giants"
programme.desc: For this episode we will travel to the Entabeni Safari Conservancy where a special family of African elephant awaits relocation. The family will be moved from a private conservation area as they have reached the carrying capacity of that area.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Impala"
programme.desc: With a high reproduction rate that leads to large numbers on reserves and are the staple diet for predators that keep their numbers in check. See how these highly adapted and unique animals get loaded and gently treated to “migrate” to a new home.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "White Rhino"
programme.desc: Another member of Africa’s Big 5 - the white rhino. Once on the brink of extinction, and today thanks to the conservation and breeding strategies, there are enough to relocate to other nature reserves to ensure the survival of this unique species.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Plains Game"
programme.desc: The technique to capture wildebeest and zebra involves an experienced team, a helicopter and favourable weather conditions! The helicopter pilot drives the herd straight into the funnel, directly into the vehicles...and on their way to a new home.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Giraffe"
programme.desc: When the animal you need to capture has a very long neck and standing almost 5 meters high, and able to spot you a mile away, you need to adapt your strategy dramatically.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Hoggs, Hippos & Hyraxes"
programme.desc: The capture team is busy in Ithala Game Reserve where several warthogs need new pastures. Meanwhile an interesting small animal, called a “dassie’ or rock hyrax is lured into traps as they are becoming a menace in the Ntshondwe camp area.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Bushbuck & Buffalo"

programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: Stoked On Fishing
programme.desc: A few years back, three guys went fishing, but that just wasn't any day of fishing. Just when you least expected it, Matt Newman caught his personal best-spotted bass, and a few minutes later, Paul Bailey caught the World Record Spotted Bass that weighed 11.5 on four different scales. The nation went bonkers. Today those three same guys are going fishing again at one of the world's best bass fishing lakes. Welcome to Clear Lake!

programme.title: FishON! | Trailblazing to Trophy Walleye: Polaris Ranger Adventure
programme.desc: Join the FishON! TV crew as we tackle rugged Northern Ontario terrain with our Polaris Ranger equipped with a custom boat rack. This remote expedition takes us deep into the wilderness to an untouched lake known for its walleye bounty. From the adrenaline of the journey to the thrill of the catch, this episode is packed with adventure, stunning scenery, and fishing tips you won’t want to miss!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | The Ultimate Baja Mexico Fishing Trip: Stoked on La Paz – Part Three
programme.desc: Welcome to La Paz, the captivating capital of Baja California Sur, situated approximately 3/4 of the way down the breathtaking Baja Peninsula. La Paz is renowned for its stunning seafront beaches, lush parks, vibrant art scene, and waterfront dining that will leave you mesmerized. Join us as we embark on a thrilling adventure diving into this coastal paradise for the very first time.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Deep in the Northern Ontario wilderness, we team up with young angler Bradly for an unforgettable day on remote waters. The walleye action doesn’t come easy—we bounce between proven hotspots, searching for the roaming schools. But once we dial them in, the bite ignites. Bradly gets his first real taste of fishing sunken timber, battling a walleye that wraps itself deep in a submerged tree, and from there the action never lets up. A perfect day in the North.

programme.title: FishON! | Remote Escapes: Pike Frenzy and Hidden Lake Explorations
programme.desc: In the thrilling Season 7 finale, Paul & Perry and the team venture deep into Northern Ontario, using a Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake with high hopes for walleye. However, the day takes a surprising turn as Northern Pike steal the show with their spirited action. Their search leads them to a farm holding the second half—and to a race against Brinkley’s gang for the gold at Silver Lake.

programme.title: Two Crosses at Danger Pass
programme.desc: Judy and Alex are the only two survivors of a punitive mission ordered by the rich and ruthless Moran.... The girl becomes his maid and the boy is adopted by a Quaker family. Alex, despite the philosophy of forgiveness he has been taught, plans to take revenge.

programme.desc: Johnny Ringo, a Texas Ranger, tracks down a counterfeiting ring, but the real challenge is a love triangle involving rancher Ray Scott, his sister Christine, saloon singer Annie, and gang boss Jackson. As Ringo tries to stop the counterfeiters, he learns the sheriff, his own partner, is behind it all, complicating the mission.

programme.title: Massacre At Grand Canyon

But what seems like an easy deal turns into a deadly trap as he crosses paths with ruthless bandits, a corrupt town boss, and a charming saloon girl whose loyalties may not be what they seem.

programme.title: Watch Out Gringo! Sabata Will Return

programme.title: Ride in the Whirlwind

Old Shatterhand, working as a surveyor, uncovers the scheme and tries to warn the Apaches to prevent war.

programme.title: Rattler Kid
programme.desc: Falsely convicted for robbing an army treasury, Tony Garrett escapes prison and sets out to find the real criminals responsible. As he hunts for revenge, he faces dangers and uncovers dark truths, determined to clear his name and make the true culprits pay for their actions.

programme.title: A Pistol for Django

programme.title: Oh Lucy! [English Subtitle]

There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: First Love [English Dub]

programme.title: Unforgivable [English Dub]

programme.title: The Night Owl [English Dub]

But while Kyoung-su is doing his work, he finds out the king’s hidden secret which might change everything that the king owns. Could Kyoung-su be able to save everyone and himself?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: There's only one round left in the tournament to decide who's going to partner up with Tyson in the World Beyblade Tag Team Championships and it's between Daichi and Kai. When Daichi finds out it's a tag team event and he's not going to go up against Tyson, he's totally enraged, but decides to beat Kai anyway. Meanwhile, the mysterious Jin is lurking around the dressing room listening in on our hero's conversations. When the finals in Block B begin, a radical jungle dish is revealed which gives Daichi the edge. Quickly, the underdog starts slamming and attacking Kai while Kai does nothing to defend himself. As Tyson and his friends watch, they nervously yell out for to attack, but Kai doesn't listen. Suddenly, as if struck by a bolt of lightening, Kai calls out for his Dranzer to attack! In one swoop, he destroys Daichi. After the battle, Kai is announced as Tyson's partner for the Tag Team Finals, but Mr. Dickenson makes an announcement that their new team, the BBA Revolution, will have two alternate players- Daichi and Kenny! And the announcement is made by Jin!! But that's not the only surprise! It turns out Jin is actually Hiro, Tyson's older brother who's come back to coach Tyson and his team!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Block A and Block B finals of the Beyblade World Championships are underway. Max wins his match and finds himself partnered with a real bully of a blader named Rick. Tyson watches the event on T.V. anxious to get in the stadium and unleash his blade Dragoon. Meanwhile Kenny discovers the real physical aspects of Beyblading. Kai watches as his friends Max and Ray win the final matches of their respective blocks for other teams. This causes him to question his loyalty to Tyson. To make matters worse, a new team comes out of nowhere and poses a threat to Tyson and his dream of winning the championship title!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The BBA Revolution Team heads to a remote training camp to prepare for the upcoming tournament. When they first arrive, Hiro tells Tyson that Kai has quit the team. Tyson is ready to quit to, but Hiro convinces him to choose a new partner. Tyson picks Daichi, then whisks him off into the wilderness to teach him survival skills as they relate to Beyblading. The plan works well until Tyson strays from the main path, and gets himself and Daichi hopelessly lost. From there it's one disaster after another: They fall in the river, lose all their equipment, and eventually get trapped by a raging forest fire. Only by working together, and using their Beyblades in perfect unison, can they save themselves and the forest. Of course that's easier said then done when it comes to Tyson and Daichi. In the end, however, they get the job done'and Tyson realizes that Daichi does in fact have what it takes to be his partner in the championship tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The BBA Revolution team fly to New York City for the Beyblade World Championships. The normally feisty Daichi proves to be afraid of flying, and once in the city, he becomes overwhelmed by the size and scope of things in the Big Apple. While eating lunch in a sidewalk caf', Tyson and Daichi have their beyblades stolen by a young pickpocket and together they scouring the streets for the culprit. Tyson meanwhile, exhibits his first real sympathy for his diminutive teammate, and vows to go easier on him. Just as the pair are about to give up the search, Tyson hears the unmistakable sounds of Dragoon coming from a nearby alley. There, they find the boy who robbed them using Dragoon to battle Rick of the PPB All Starz in a street match. Rick wins and prepares to leave with his stolen bounty. Tyson and Daichi try to convince Rick to give back their blades, but Rick will only return them if they defeat him in a match. The three bladers engage in battle, with Tyson and Daichi tag-teaming Rick. Rick is on the verge of defeating them when a surprise fourth blader jumps in ' Max. The match ends in a draw, and Rick leaves empty-handed. Max vows to try and improve his relationship with Rick, who's his PPB All Starz teammate. Back at their Hotel, the BBA Revolution team watch the sports news on TV, and learn that the other teams in the Championship Tournament have all arrived in New York City. But the most shocking news, is that a surprise addition has been made to the mysterious Blitzkrieg Boys team ' their former teammate Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The teams have been selected and the finals are about to begin'Unfortunately Tyson finds himself facing all of his former friends'each part of a team that he will eventually have to 'blade against. The biggest blow that Tyson receives, is seeing Kai as a member of the Blitzkrieg Boys! After confronting his sullen, ex-teammate, Kai suggests to Tyson that the reason he left is because his old team just wasn't good enough! Tyson is insulted to the core'even more so when Ray chooses to let Lee face-off against Tyson in the first match, White Tiger X versus BBA Revolution! In an attempt to prove his worth, Tyson makes an arrogant demand: he insists on 'blading the two White Tiger X team members at the same time! Can Tyson and his relatively untrained partner Daichi even hope to succeed?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson blames his embarrassing loss to Ray on Daichi, telling the team he's better off competing alone. As Tyson runs away, the US Finals continue with Rick of the PPB All Starz against Claude of Barthez Battalion. Claude's skill gives him the upper hand until Rick's unleashes his full power, destroying the stadium to get to Rapid Eagle. Barthez orders Claude not to avoid the shrapnel and he is injured, turning the crowd against the PPB All Starz. Despite losing, Barthez is delighted to have undermined the US's popularity. Hiro finds Tyson and challenges him to a duel, defeating him easily. Tyson makes more excuses ' the World Champion can never show weakness. Hiro walks away' until Tyson allows himself to admit his weakness, he will never grow stronger.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade World Tag Team Championships are about to start in Rome as Barthez busily prepares his team for the big event. He's even invited a television news crew to document his efforts as a coach. Unfortunately, Barthez's personality slips through on occasion revealing the truth about how much a tyrant he really is. The Italian tournament begins and it's Barthez Battalion against White Tiger X. Ray starts for the Tigers going up against Claude. In mere seconds, Ray pulls off a victory that sets off alarm bells among the other competitors who think something is fishy. The second battle has Lee and Miguel pitted against each other. It doesn't take long for Miguel to win the match for Barthez Battalion which sets up the third and final round- Miguel against Ray! This battle starts off with Ray on the offensive, but suddenly, blades spring out of Miguel's blade and KABOOM! Miguel wins! Kenny, watching this on a monitor, is very suspicious of the victory just as Hiro enters to give the line-up for the next battle... which doesn't include Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson gets in a huff and leaves the team after he is dropped from the lineup against the Blitzkrieg Boys. This leaves Kenny and Daichi to pick up the slack against their opponents. Feeling rejected, Tyson wanders off and runs into a strange old man named Tao who takes him shopping. Meanwhile the competition rolls on and the PPB All Stars are victorious. Next up, the Blitzkrieg Boys face off against the BBA Revolution without Tyson. Daichi wins his match and Kenny nervously goes to the beystadium to face his opponent Tala. During the battle, Kenny finds himself way out of his league but when Tala starts to insult Tyson he discovers his blading spirit and vows to never give up and win the match for his friend!'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In the second of a best of three match, Tala thinks he's broken Kenny down, but Kenny summons his inner strength and attacks with all of his combined power. Unfortunately, it's not enough, and Tala shatters Kenny's Hopper into pieces with his Novae Rog attack. Kenny loses the match, but in the process spots a major weakness in Tala's game. Daichi is called to take on Tala in the tie-breaker. Tyson is desperate for the win, and tries to convince Tala to let him fight in Daichi's place. Tala refuses, and Daichi is furious that Tyson has so little faith in his abilities. Meanwhile, Kenny rigs Daichi's Beyblade with a special part to help him in the battle. He convinces Daichi to follow his game plan, and stay away from Tala's 'blade until the perfect moment. Daichi agrees, but it goes against his natural style and it takes all his strength just to keep from attacking. Finally Kenny spots the opening, and Daichi takes advantage. Daichi defeats Tala, and the BBA Revolution is awarded the victory. Tyson is humbled, and vows never to underestimate his teammates again.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In Madrid for the Spanish leg of the World Championships, the hard-of-sleeping Lee has a nightmare that Ray kicks him off the team for his poor play. The day before their next match, White Tiger X encounters a pair of beyblading jugglers in Madrid's main square, who also happen to be trick bladers. When Lee criticizes their performance, he and Ray are challenged to an impromptu match. The jugglers beat them handily, which only exacerbates Lee's insecurity about his skills. Ray suspects that Lee's problem stems not only from a lack of sleep lately, but from a lack of communication between the two. Ray discusses the problem with Tyson, who suggests that Ray be more confrontational. Mr. Dickenson meanwhile, ponders whether to grant F Dynasty their request for a two-on-two match. Turns out it was Raul and Julia of F Dynasty who posed as the street jugglers in order to goad Lee and Ray. When the day of the match arrives, and White Tiger X faces F Dynasty, Lee and Ray discover the jugglers' true identities. Wanting payback for their earlier loss, Lee and Ray accept the two-on-two challenge and the match format is set. F Dynasty dominates the contest, causing Lee to go batty in fear of letting Ray down yet again. Coming loose at the seams, Lee's reckless blading becomes a serious concern. To save his fragile-minded teammate from further distress, Ray knocks out Lee's blade himself and accept his team's loss. Discussing the incident afterward, Lee acknowledges his mistake, and he and Ray vow to be more communicative in the future.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: As Max prepares to face Kai in the next round, the members of BBA Revolution overhear a confrontation between Johnny and Robert of the Majestics and Barthez Battalion. It turns out Barthez Battalion won their qualifying tournament through trickery. Thanks to Kenny, the teams find proof of Barthez's underhanded tactics but it's too late to disqualify them from the Championships. Armed with his new Draciel Gravity, Max takes Kai to the edge of defeat only to end up defeated himself. Rick uses his frustration at the loss to overcome Tala and goes on to face Kai in a tiebreaker. Despite his great power, Rick loses to the more experienced Kai. Inspired by the match, Tyson vows to face Barthez Battalion with everything he's got.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The BBA Revolution are slated to face the sneaky Barthez Battalion, but while Hilary and Kenny want to report their dirty deeds to the authorities, Tyson believes the best way to teach them a lesson is to beat them fair and square'But that's before he really sees how low the team will sink to win. When Mathilda blows up her beyblade on purpose, just to cause damage to Daichi's Strata Dragoon, Tyson and his team are shocked'But Tyson stands his ground! Although Daichi wants to give Jean Paul Barthez himself a piece of his mind'Tyson holds him back, knowing that all will be decided in the beyblade dish'or will it? Tyson prepares to face off against Miguel, but how will he fare against the team leader's own dirty tricks'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes land in Egypt for the next leg of the tournament where the first two teams going up against each other are the Blitzkrieg Boys against the Barthez Battalion. But as Barthez readies his team, we learn he's devised a special spider web-like tape that is supposed to shoot out of his team's blades and trap their opponents in an inescapable web. Miguel is torn and knows that if they follow his coach's plan they could win, but he feels he'd rather lose with respect than cheat. In the first battle, Aaron goes up against Tala. Barthez tells his players to just act natural and he would operate the spider webbing by remote control. As the battle begins, Barthez desperately pushes the remote control, but nothing happens. Turns out Aaron refused to use the 'fixed' blade. Barthez is furious. Miguel is defiant and tell Barthez that they aren't going to be 'his puppets anymore.' As Barthez leaves, Miguel steps into the ring against Kai. The battle doesn't last very long as Kai wins handily. But Miguel has lost with dignity and that's just the way he wants it!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is having trouble convincing Rick that he is truly dedicated to the PPB All Starz. Max just wants to play for love of the game but Rick thinks he should do anything to win. When the competition continues Max demands they fight a 'pairs' match so that he and Rick are forced to work as a team. Rick's ego gets the best of him and soon he finds himself not only battling the White Tiger X team but Max as well. Mariah tells Ray and Lee of White Tiger X that they should battle each other and find out who is the best blader out of the four of them. A beyblading free for all ensues until the final climactic battle when only one blade is left spinning. The winner is surprised as everyone else to learn that he is the best blader of them all!'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Egyptian leg of the World Championships culminates with the final match highlighting F Dynasty against the BBA Revolution. The day before the match, Tyson has Daichi practice moves with him that they're not usually accustomed to doing: namely, tag-team attacks. F Dynasty is renowned for their tag-team abilities, and Tyson wants nothing more than to beat them at their own game. He knows this will be a challenge, as F Dynasty has already used the tag-team format to defeat White Tiger X earlier in the tournament. But as the former Beyblade world champion, Tyson feels it's his duty to prove that he's the best, no matter what the format is. F Dynasty meanwhile, foregoes practicing in favor of another fantastic street show of their beyblading skills for a crowd of onlookers. In a flashback to their childhood, we learn that Raul and Julia have been performing as a duo since their formative years growing up in the circus. The introduction of beyblades to their act only solidified their skills. When the day of the match arrives, Tyson specifically requests the two-on-two format and F Dynasty agrees. The sand-filled Sahara dish gives Tyson and Daichi the pre-battle advantage, but during the match, Tyson's beyblade has trouble keeping up. Coach Hiro realizes that the pressure Tyson is feeling to carry his team as the former Beyblade champion is affecting his performance.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is feeling the pressure of being World Champion. Despite Hiro's warning, a television crew follows him around for a day, taping his every move. Daichi feels jealous and tries to compete for the camera's attention. Finally, BBA Revolution holds a three-way match between Tyson, Daichi and Kenny for the cameras and Tyson loses like an amateur. Tyson contemplates quitting and wanders to the Beystadium to be alone with his thoughts. Daichi confronts him and challenges him to a match. During the beybattle, Tyson is reminded of how it feels to beyblade for the pure love of the game. The pressure disappears when Tyson realizes he doesn't have to beyblade like a champion. He just has to beyblade like himself! Tyson meets Kai, Max and Ray ands tells them that, from now on, they are all challengers and any one of them could end up as champion.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final elimination round is underway, with F Dynasty trying to earn the last play-off slot, while their opponents, the already mathematically eliminated Barthez Battalion try to spoil their chances. Feeling like the weak link of the team, Raul surprises Julia by insisting he battle solo for F Dynasty, in order to prove his worth. Julia reluctantly agrees. In the first match Julia easily defeats Miguel, piling even more pressure on Raul. Raul is up against Mathilda of Barthez Battalion (who is using a combination of parts from her team's Beyblades) in the second match. Raul freezes under the pressure, and it looks like he is a sitting duck. But Julia steps in to explain to Raul that the only reason she has so much confidence in battle is because she has him at her side. This fires Raul up, and he battles back to steal the victory. The Barthez Battalion team are eliminated, but they are very gracious in defeat.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With Lee losing to Tala early in the match, White Tiger X is a game down, and Kai now steps up to battle for the Blitzkrieg Boys. This round is sure to be intense, as old teammates face off in the dish. Ray will represent White Tiger X, and the world is watching. The pressure seems too much for the players, as Ray collapses from the strain. Somehow he finds the strength to keep going, and the desire to bring Kai down! The intensity rises as the battle continues, with both players on either side of the dish so evenly matched, who can predict which one will walk away with the victory?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The fight is a tough one. In fact, the combatants are going at it so hard that the entire arena is filled with the acrid smell of burnt metal. This seems to be a battle of wills rather than blades as each Blader attempts to summon every ounce of power that they can. In the end, Daichi proves to be the winner, and Rick is devastated. Daichi on the other hand has used so much energy that he passes out. Now it's time for the next round, and it pits Tyson against his former teammate, Max!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Max face off against each other in the semi-final of the World Beyblading Championships. The two old friends use two totally different blading styles in the dish. Tyson takes the offense while Max hangs back and chooses for a more defensive style. Tyson has a tough time battling Max and when Dragoon starts to lose power he starts his engine gear. When he goes in for the final hit, Max suddenly goes on the offense and starts Draciel's engine gear. Just when it looks like Dragoon is going to be knocked out Tyson cleverly uses Draciel's own power against it and defeats Max! This allows Tyson's team, the BBA Revolution, to move on to the final round of the competition!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three teams qualifying for the finals of the World Beyblade Championships ' the Blitzkrieg Boys, the BBA Revolution, and F Dynasty - the BBA must make a decision. Only two teams can play in the finals, and a format to determine which ones will compete must be decided. Will they stage a mini-round robin tournament between the three teams? Or will the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty, who are both tied for second place battle, with the winner moving on to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in the finals? These questions will all take time to answer - time the various competitors use to catch up with family members. With the PPB All Starz eliminated from the tournament, Max visits his folks and then drops by the local community center where he and Ray first told Tyson they were leaving the Bladebreakers. Tyson goes home to visit Grandpa, and Daichi tags along, making himself a little too at home in the process. Grandpa is impressed by Tyson's newfound seriousness when it comes to his martial arts training. Coach Romero of F Dynasty gives Raul and Julia a surprise when he brings them to visit the circus, which just happens to be in town. The circus is where the siblings grew up, and a heartfelt reunion ensues. At BBA Headquarters, Mr. Dickenson announces the finals format. The two second place teams will indeed face each other first, with the victor getting to advance. Tyson surprises everyone by requesting that his match be a tag-team battle. Kenny gives Tyson his newly created Dragoon Galaxy Turbo, an improved version of Dragoon, which performs well in tag-team practice. Tyson and Daichi are pumped - they couldn't be more ready for their upcoming rematch against F Dynasty.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The entire city is pumped for Tyson and Daichi's rematch with F Dynasty in double-team play. At first, the awesome power of BBA Revolution has Raul and Julia on their heels. Raul manages to save Julia from a stadium out and his big sister lets him take command. Encouraged by the support of their circus family, the brother and sister use their experience and teamwork to push the BBA Revolution to the brink of defeat. Tyson and Daichi are losing strength when they realize they are having the time of their lives. There's nothing like competing against powerful, skilled opponents. The BBA Revolution has one last shot at victory. Can Daichi and Tyson manage to use a risky move from F Dynasty's playbook to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? When Tyson's gambit wins the match, Raul and Julia are stunned to hear the crowd cheering for the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty! They are overwhelmed with pride as Kai leaves the stadium. At last, he will face Tyson for the World Championship.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals have finally arrived and BBA Revolution gets ready to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in a heated battle. But before that can happen, a routine check-up of Tyson's Beyblade turns up a faulty gear assembly, which needs to be repaired! Time is running out, and Daichi has to stretch out his match with Tala to give Kenny the time he needs to fix Dragoon! Just when things look their bleakest, Kenny brings Dragoon back to its former glory, which gets Daichi off the hook! And now, instead of running away from Tala, he comes back with an intense attack! But is it too late to get back the advantage over his crafty opponent?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Daichi and Tala have both been thrown from the dish at the same time, resulting in a tie game. Because they are in no condition for a rematch, Mr. Dickenson rules that the next match will determine the new tournament Champion. It all comes down to Kai and Tyson. Kai shows up for the match battered and bruised from his training session with Spencer and Bryan, just so he can put himself at Tyson's level of physical exhaustion, since Tyson had already battled earlier in the day. Kai wants them to be evenly matched so that he won't have any advantage in battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now a dilemma arises. Mr. Dickenson has to make the final decision and he's leaning toward calling it a tie because he's afraid that if they continue the battle, someone could get hurt. But Kai steps up to the plate and pleads his case for the battle to continue, which it does! As the fight resumes, the intensity is felt throughout the arena. Again they are evenly matched and it looks like no one will take it, when' they both mount a final assault! It's huge! In the end, Tyson comes out on top and Daichi and Tyson become the new Beyblade Tag Team World Champions!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi win the Beyblade Tag Team World Championship but Daichi is jealous that Tyson is getting all the attention. He decides the only way he can get the respect he deserves is to go on a training mission and come back and defeat Tyson on his own. He hitches a ride on a truck and falls asleep but wakes up far away from home, alone and hungry. Luckily he runs into Max and his father who invite him back to their house for dinner. During the meal Max squirts mustard on Daichi's steak telling him it will make it taste better. This disgusts Daichi, and in his anger he insults Max and his father. Max takes offense and challenges Daichi to a Beyblade battle. The match is a close one and Daichi is confident he can beat Max but he was beaten by Max's strength. He decides that the only way he can become a better Blader is to start training with Max. Meanwhile Tyson discovers Daichi gone and wonders why and where his Blading partner has gone.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A news bulletin announces that the BBA has been bought and transformed into a new, professional league, named the BEGA League and that Mr. Dickenson has resigned from his position as Chairman. The kids go off in search of their old friend and demand an explanation. Ashamed, Mr. Dickenson reveals that the board of the BBA had completed the plans to sell the league while he was occupied with the World Championships. Tyson resolves to show up at the press conference the next day and discover who is behind the plot. But at the press conference, he is faced with the new singing sensation, Ming-Ming who announces that not only is she the official mascot of the BEGA League but also its top ranked professional Beyblader. Tyson challenges her to Beybattle and Ming-Ming accepts under the condition that Tyson beat her entire Ming-Ming Band. Will Tyson, Max and Daichi be able to beat the Beybattling band and face off against an old foe?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max, Kenny and Daichi are invited by Boris to take a tour inside his new BEGA headquarters. Hilary isn't allowed inside until the official public opening, and is sent away, much to her chagrin. The boys find that the BEGA building is unparalleled in the quality of its Beyblade training and facilities. Impressive as it is however, Tyson is still highly distrustful of Boris, who was responsible for trying to take over the world two years ago by using his team the Demolition Boys as soldiers. Boris tries to convince Tyson that he's changed. Ever since his scheme was uncovered, he roamed throughout his homeland doing some soul searching. There, while watching some village children Beyblade, he had an epiphany. He realized that Beyblading is all about honor and individuality, and he made it his new goal to bring Beyblading to the masses. That's why he took over the BBA and turned it into BEGA ' as a way to give children around the world that had no exposure to the game a chance to better their lives and become champions themselves. Tyson is still skeptical, and his bad-mouthing of Boris draws the ire of a top BEGA prospect ' a juggernaut named Crusher, whose Beyblade launcher is the biggest one the boys have ever seen. When grilled by Tyson about his motives for joining this professional league, Crusher admits he's doing it for the prospect of getting rich, but only so he can afford to pay his younger sister's hospital bills. A Beybattle ensues, and Crusher shows he's even more powerful than he looks. Tyson is nearly defeated, but he summons his will and narrowly defeats his jumbo-sized opponent. When Boris asks Tyson if he now believes he's sincere in his reasons for creating BEGA, Tyson still isn't sure. But Tyson does admit that if spirited and honorable Blader's like Crusher are in it, maybe there is some merit in the new league after all.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger wanders the woods of White Tiger Hills, the headquarters of the White Tiger X team, and although this strange young man performs incredible good deeds, Lee and the rest of the team are suspicious, and tell their leader Ray, all about him. It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament.
